documentation.name: AGENTS.md
documentation.summary: Defines the repository-wide engineering contract for BeneBot, including its synthetic-only scope, historical-versus-current evidence boundary, server-side integrations, deterministic billing math, security rules, and validation gates.

documentation.name: BENEBOT_BUILD_SPEC.md
documentation.summary: Canonical end-to-end specification for BeneBot's Jane Doe demo, covering architecture, FHIR resources, deterministic bill normalization, signed sessions, Deepgram voice, Stedi eligibility, resource search, Medplum writes, UI contracts, testing, and phased delivery.

documentation.name: BENEBOT_RESEARCH_AGENT_PROMPTS.md
documentation.summary: Defines six bounded research lanes and a final independent adjudication prompt for producing BeneBot's authoritative bilingual concept, misconception, utterance, rubric, and tool-prerequisite packet.

documentation.name: CLAUDE.md
documentation.summary: Redirects Claude-compatible agents to the canonical repository instructions in AGENTS.md so all coding assistants share the same safety and delivery constraints.

documentation.name: CODEX_START_PROMPT.md
documentation.summary: Provides a copy-ready kickoff prompt that tells Codex to ground itself in the build specification, execute one phase at a time, preserve strict evidence boundaries, and run each required validation gate.

documentation.name: CONVERSATION_RELIABILITY_PLAN.md
documentation.summary: Plans the bounded reliability layer for BeneBot conversations: eight phase-aware rubrics, closed-tool prerequisites, deterministic enforcement, an adjudicated bilingual concept library, evidence-linked transcript evaluation, and staged integration.

documentation.name: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
documentation.summary: Translates the build specification into a time-boxed Spanish-first hackathon execution plan with fixed technical choices, staged work waves, validation checkpoints, demo choreography, and an explicit fallback-and-cut ladder.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Operational runbook for installing, configuring, seeding, testing, and rehearsing BeneBot, with explicit setup instructions for Medplum, Deepgram, and Stedi plus honest degraded-mode behavior and the Spanish-first demo script.

documentation.name: spanish-review-notes.md
documentation.summary: Records the linguistic review rationale behind the Spanish concept library, including U.S. Latino regional choices, billing-term distinctions, false friends, remaining ambiguities, and pronunciation guidance for voice output.

documentation.name: INTEGRATION_NOTES.md
documentation.summary: Records how the approved research packet was incorporated into the bounded Jane Doe P0 while keeping patient-specific values out of prompts. It also resolves conflicts between research rubrics, unsupported tool prerequisites, runtime authority, and evaluation-only material.

documentation.name: adjudication-report.md
documentation.summary: Documents the final adjudication of six BeneBot research packets, including the accepted six-concept P0 vocabulary, repaired bilingual analogies, evaluation-only content, and rejected unsafe material. The report recommends the reconciled packet for bounded P0 incorporation.

documentation.name: source-ledger.md
documentation.summary: Traces the packet's factual boundaries, English and Spanish concept content, analogy decisions, and synthetic bilingual evaluation cases back to five upstream research sources. A coverage matrix exposes source gaps and normalized concept identifiers for the six-concept P0 set.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: Defines the private Next.js application package, its development, type-check, Vitest, Playwright, build, and Medplum seed scripts, and runtime dependencies for Deepgram UI, Medplum FHIR, JWT handling, and Zod validation.

config.name: spanish-concept-library.json
config.summary: Stores six es-419 medical-billing concepts with preferred and alternative terminology, patient-facing explanations, confusion repairs, bounded analogies, comprehension checks, utterance variants, forbidden claims, and pronunciation guidance.

config.name: tsconfig.json
config.summary: Configures strict TypeScript checking for the Next.js application with ESNext modules, React JSX, incremental compilation, the @ path alias, and generated Next.js type inputs.

config.name: canonical-concepts.json
config.summary: Defines the canonical English and Spanish health-literacy library for six P0 billing concepts. Each entry combines preferred terminology, definitions, utterance variants, comprehension checks, Spanish pronunciation guidance, and shared factual boundaries.

config.name: eight-rubric-spec.json
config.summary: Defines eight prioritized research evaluation dimensions covering financial non-invention, historical/current separation, prerequisite tool ordering, confirmed external outcomes, bilingual equivalence, natural language, safe analogies, and conversational warmth.

config.name: runtime-concepts.json
config.summary: Provides runtime-oriented English and Spanish explanation patterns for the six P0 billing concepts, including first explanations, confusion repairs, forbidden phrases, optional analogies, and explicit analogy boundaries. Integration notes constrain patient-specific values in this research artifact from entering live prompt guidance.

config.name: tool-prerequisite-matrix.json
config.summary: Maps patient-specific claims about the six P0 billing concepts to the research packet's proposed prerequisite tools. The integration notes treat this matrix as evaluation provenance because several named tools and requested facts are unsupported by the closed BeneBot runtime tool set.

config.name: benebot-fhir-seed.json
config.summary: Defines the synthetic FHIR R4 transaction bundle for BeneBot's Jane Doe billing scenario, linking the patient, provider, payer, coverage, encounter, ExplanationOfBenefit, and invoice. Its adjudication totals encode the canonical reconciled $620 patient-responsibility example used by the demo and tests.

config.name: demo-resources.json
config.summary: Catalogs five bilingual synthetic support resources for payment plans, billing review, payer contact, advocacy, and financial assistance. Each record carries provenance, verification status, fictional-data disclosure, contact hours, and prioritized English and Spanish instructions.

config.name: stedi-aetna-test-request.json
config.summary: Captures the sole synthetic Aetna eligibility request permitted for BeneBot's Stedi test integration. It fixes the trading partner, provider NPI, Jane Doe subscriber identity, and service type 30 so deviations can fail before a network call.

config.name: stedi-normalized-fallback.json
config.summary: Provides a visibly labeled normalized fallback for current-benefits retrieval when live Stedi test data is unavailable. It preserves a separate check timestamp, deductible and out-of-pocket scopes, sample copay and coinsurance details, and warnings that the fallback does not explain historical claim adjudication.

config.name: config.json
config.summary: Stores project-level Understand Anything preferences, currently selecting English for generated knowledge-graph text.

config.name: demo-resources.json
config.summary: Provides five bilingual synthetic support-resource records used by the fallback search provider, preserving practice, fictional, and community-reported provenance along with explicit verification disclosures and priority ordering.

list.name: Patient and Staff Experience
list.description: Next.js pages, shared styling, and accessible React components present the synthetic bill, bilingual voice and text conversation, deterministic arithmetic, and staff-visible workflow timeline.

list.name: Authenticated Server API
list.description: Next.js route handlers enforce the signed BeneBot session boundary while exposing the closed bill, benefits, resources, follow-up, summary, and temporary Deepgram-token operations.

list.name: Deterministic Billing and Trust Core
list.description: Pure billing normalization and reconciliation, shared contracts, scoped JWT sessions, and sanitized errors keep financial explanations deterministic and patient access fail-closed.

list.name: Bilingual Voice and Conversation Policy
list.description: Deepgram configuration, the English/Spanish billing dictionary, tool prerequisites, deterministic fallback routing, and the closed tool bridge govern every spoken or typed conversation.

list.name: Healthcare Integrations and FHIR Workflow
list.description: Server-only adapters validate configuration, read and write scoped Medplum FHIR R4 resources, refresh timestamped Stedi eligibility, and search disclosure-preserving support resources.

list.name: Synthetic Demo and Evaluation Evidence
list.description: FHIR fixtures, guarded Stedi inputs, bilingual resource catalogs, adjudicated concept packets, and transcript cases provide the safe synthetic evidence used by the demo and its reliability checks.

list.name: Verification and Conversation Evaluation
list.description: Executable rubrics plus unit, integration, and browser tests prove the reconciled bill math, security boundaries, bilingual behavior, external-workflow confirmation, and full Jane Doe happy path.

list.name: Product, Safety, and Delivery Documentation
list.description: The canonical specification, repository policies, research prompts, reliability plan, runbook, and execution guides preserve BeneBot's synthetic-only scope and historical-versus-current evidence boundary.

list.name: Build, Test, Analysis, and Seed Tooling
list.description: Strict TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Vitest, Playwright, lint, knowledge-graph, package, and idempotent Medplum seed controls make the demo reproducible and inspectable.

file:app/api/tools/get-bill-context/rout.name: route.ts
file:app/api/tools/get-bill-context/rout.summary: Authenticated POST endpoint that loads the session-scoped historical bill from Medplum, allows an explicitly configured fixture fallback, refuses unreconciled math, and returns deterministic bilingual narration.

file:components/voice/benebot-panel.tsx.name: benebot-panel.tsx
file:components/voice/benebot-panel.tsx.summary: Primary bilingual voice-and-text experience that connects Deepgram Agent hooks to the five BeneBot server tools, preserves deterministic billing narration, handles fallback routing, and displays confirmed benefit and follow-up results.

file:components/voice/tool-activity.tsx.name: tool-activity.tsx
file:components/voice/tool-activity.tsx.summary: Accessible status list showing the five most recent BeneBot tool operations as running, confirmed, or failed.

file:components/voice/transcript.tsx.name: transcript.tsx
file:components/voice/transcript.tsx.summary: Conversation renderer that combines Deepgram entries with text-fallback messages and shows a privacy-oriented empty state.

file:lib/billing/historical-narration.ts.name: historical-narration.ts
file:lib/billing/historical-narration.ts.summary: Pure formatter for a complete English and Spanish historical-claim explanation using only already-normalized values and an explicit historical-versus-current limitation.

file:lib/contracts.ts.name: contracts.ts
file:lib/contracts.ts.summary: Shared TypeScript contracts for the closed five-tool surface, historical bill data, current benefits, support resources, follow-up Tasks, concise Communications, and activity events.

file:lib/deepgram/concept-guidance.ts.name: concept-guidance.ts
file:lib/deepgram/concept-guidance.ts.summary: Code-owned bilingual healthcare-billing dictionary for six adjudicated concepts, including preferred terms, safe analogies, analogy boundaries, and prohibited phrasings.

file:lib/deepgram/config.ts.name: config.ts
file:lib/deepgram/config.ts.summary: Builds Spanish- or English-specific Deepgram Agent configuration with Flux multilingual recognition, billing keyterms, matching Aura voices, a low-temperature reasoning model, temporary-token auth, and bounded reconnect behavior.

file:lib/deepgram/prerequisites.ts.name: prerequisites.ts
file:lib/deepgram/prerequisites.ts.summary: Defines the use conditions, server-confirmed prerequisites, permitted outputs, and fail-closed behavior for each of BeneBot's five tools.

file:lib/deepgram/prompt.ts.name: prompt.ts
file:lib/deepgram/prompt.ts.summary: Safety-focused system prompt separating historical EOB adjudication from current Stedi eligibility, requiring deterministic tool narration, fixed session language, explicit confirmation, and server-verified external actions.

file:lib/deepgram/text-fallback.ts.name: text-fallback.ts
file:lib/deepgram/text-fallback.ts.summary: Deterministic bilingual text-intent router that preserves the same historical/current separation, clarification, hardship-resource, confirmation, and summary-saving flow when voice is unavailable.

file:lib/deepgram/tools.ts.name: tools.ts
file:lib/deepgram/tools.ts.summary: Defines the exact five Deepgram tools, validates their arguments with Zod, maps them to authenticated server routes, and reports sanitized running, success, or failure activity.

file:lib/resources/provider.ts.name: provider.ts
file:lib/resources/provider.ts.summary: Validates and searches the local synthetic support-resource fixture, ranks practice-provided results first, caps output at three, localizes content, and preserves disclosure metadata.

file:tests/resource-provider.test.ts.name: resource-provider.test.ts
file:tests/resource-provider.test.ts.summary: Verifies that local support resources prioritize practice-provided entries, localize requested content, and preserve unverified community labels.

file:tests/unit/deepgram-config.test.ts.name: deepgram-config.test.ts
file:tests/unit/deepgram-config.test.ts.summary: Checks that Spanish and English sessions use matching Flux language hints, native Aura voices, and language-specific prompts.

file:tests/unit/deepgram-prompt.test.ts.name: deepgram-prompt.test.ts
file:tests/unit/deepgram-prompt.test.ts.summary: Validates the six safe billing concepts, exact five-tool prerequisite set, deterministic narration rules, and fixed voice-session language policy.

file:tests/unit/deepgram-tools.test.ts.name: deepgram-tools.test.ts
file:tests/unit/deepgram-tools.test.ts.summary: Tests the closed five-tool bridge, signed-session forwarding, argument rejection before network access, and confirmation-only follow-up payloads.

file:tests/unit/historical-narration.tes.name: historical-narration.test.ts
file:tests/unit/historical-narration.tes.summary: Proves historical narration includes source and temporal limits, suppresses all financial numbers when reconciliation fails, and never recalculates tool-returned values.

file:tests/unit/text-fallback.test.ts.name: text-fallback.test.ts
file:tests/unit/text-fallback.test.ts.summary: Exercises bilingual disconnected routing for bill and current-benefit requests, interruption, hardship, confirmation-gated follow-up, end-of-session clarity, and mixed-language summaries.

file:app/api/benebot/session/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/benebot/session/route.ts.summary: Creates a rate-limited synthetic BeneBot session for the fixed demo invoice, resolving Medplum seed identifiers when available and failing closed for configured-but-broken Medplum access.

file:app/api/deepgram-token/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/deepgram-token/route.ts.summary: Issues a five-minute Deepgram temporary access token to an authenticated, rate-limited BeneBot session while keeping the long-lived Deepgram API key server-only.

file:app/api/tools/refresh-benefits/rout.name: route.ts
file:app/api/tools/refresh-benefits/rout.summary: Refreshes current benefits through the guarded Stedi test provider, optionally persists the successful snapshot to Medplum, and returns a deterministic bilingual spoken summary distinct from historical claim data.

file:app/api/tools/request-followup/rout.name: route.ts
file:app/api/tools/request-followup/rout.summary: Creates a Medplum billing-review Task only after explicit patient confirmation, strict input validation, session-scope verification, and server confirmation of the persisted resource ID.

file:app/api/tools/save-summary/route.ts.name: route.ts
file:app/api/tools/save-summary/route.ts.summary: Persists a bounded conversation summary as a Medplum Communication, keeping language, answered questions, resources, follow-up, and unresolved issues structured without storing a transcript.

file:app/api/tools/search-resources/rout.name: route.ts
file:app/api/tools/search-resources/rout.summary: Searches the local support-resource provider using only generic need and language filters so patient and claim data never leave BeneBot through resource discovery.

file:lib/env.ts.name: env.ts
file:lib/env.ts.summary: Defines and validates server-only BeneBot configuration, constraining Stedi to its fixed test identifiers and exposing typed guards for Medplum, Deepgram, and Stedi credentials.

file:lib/errors.ts.name: errors.ts
file:lib/errors.ts.summary: Centralizes typed BeneBot errors and sanitized HTTP responses, preserving intentional user-safe messages while logging unexpected failures only with an opaque request ID and error class.

file:lib/medplum/server.ts.name: server.ts
file:lib/medplum/server.ts.summary: Provides the server-only Medplum client boundary, credential-state detection, client-credentials login, and a retry-safe cached client promise.

file:lib/medplum/write-artifacts.ts.name: write-artifacts.ts
file:lib/medplum/write-artifacts.ts.summary: Validates every FHIR reference against the signed session before idempotently creating Medplum Task, Communication, CoverageEligibilityRequest, and CoverageEligibilityResponse workflow artifacts.

file:lib/session.ts.name: session.ts
file:lib/session.ts.summary: Implements signed, short-lived BeneBot JWT sessions bound to one synthetic patient, invoice, EOB, coverage, encounter, provider, and payer, plus bearer parsing and in-memory demo rate limiting.

file:lib/stedi/eligibility.ts.name: eligibility.ts
file:lib/stedi/eligibility.ts.summary: Guards the fixed Jane Doe Stedi test request, normalizes only unambiguous payer fields, performs the sole permitted deductible derivation in deterministic code, and produces timestamped English/Spanish spoken summaries.

file:tests/integration/medplum-billing-c.name: medplum-billing-case.test.ts
file:tests/integration/medplum-billing-c.summary: Integration tests prove that billing-review Tasks contain only confirmed scoped fields, omit transcripts, and are never written when the EOB-to-encounter relationship violates the signed session.

file:tests/stedi-eligibility.test.ts.name: stedi-eligibility.test.ts
file:tests/stedi-eligibility.test.ts.summary: Tests the fixed-identity pre-network guard, literal Stedi request, conservative benefit normalization, scope-safe deductible derivation, bilingual historical/current disclaimer, and visibly non-live fixture fallback.

file:tests/unit/session.test.ts.name: session.test.ts
file:tests/unit/session.test.ts.summary: Unit tests cover valid bill-scoped sessions and reject tampered, expired, wrong-audience, or incomplete JWTs.

file:app/staff/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:app/staff/page.tsx.summary: Renders the Spanish staff proof view and loads server-confirmed Medplum eligibility, Task, and Communication artifacts while failing closed to clearly labeled seeded records.

file:components/staff/artifact-timeline..name: artifact-timeline.tsx
file:components/staff/artifact-timeline..summary: Defines the typed workflow-artifact view model and renders an accessible chronological list of EOB, invoice, eligibility, Task, and Communication records.

file:lib/billing/math.ts.name: math.ts
file:lib/billing/math.ts.summary: Implements deterministic medical-bill reconciliation for allowed charges, patient responsibility, and insurer payment using a one-cent tolerance and fail-closed validation.

file:lib/billing/normalize-eob.ts.name: normalize-eob.ts
file:lib/billing/normalize-eob.ts.summary: Normalizes FHIR ExplanationOfBenefit adjudication into a deterministic billing structure, preserves missing values as errors outside the controlled fixture, and refuses numerical explanation when reconciliation fails.

file:lib/billing/types.ts.name: types.ts
file:lib/billing/types.ts.summary: Defines the normalized bill, patient, provider, payer, service, invoice, adjudication, and reconciliation contracts consumed across the deterministic billing pipeline.

file:lib/medplum/constants.ts.name: constants.ts
file:lib/medplum/constants.ts.summary: Centralizes BeneBot FHIR identifier systems and stable synthetic demo identifiers for idempotent Medplum lookups and writes.

file:lib/medplum/demo-fixture.ts.name: demo-fixture.ts
file:lib/medplum/demo-fixture.ts.summary: Validates the synthetic FHIR transaction Bundle and provides type-safe accessors for its Patient, Organization, Coverage, Encounter, EOB, and Invoice resources.

file:lib/medplum/queries.ts.name: queries.ts
file:lib/medplum/queries.ts.summary: Builds patient-scoped normalized bill contexts from Medplum or the labeled local fixture, validates all FHIR reference relationships, and resolves seeded resources through stable identifiers.

file:scripts/seed-medplum.ts.name: seed-medplum.ts
file:scripts/seed-medplum.ts.summary: Validates the canonical synthetic billing Bundle, seeds its FHIR resources into Medplum idempotently by stable identifier, resolves dependent references, and confirms every server write.

file:tests/integration/fixture-bill-cont.name: fixture-bill-context.test.ts
file:tests/integration/fixture-bill-cont.summary: Integration test proving that the local fixture produces a session-scoped, reconciled $620 context with Spanish preference, minimal patient data, and an explicit Medplum fallback warning.

file:tests/unit/billing-math.test.ts.name: billing-math.test.ts
file:tests/unit/billing-math.test.ts.summary: Unit tests the deterministic billing equations, one-cent tolerance, discrepancy behavior, and rejection of invalid financial amounts.

file:tests/unit/eob-normalizer.test.ts.name: eob-normalizer.test.ts
file:tests/unit/eob-normalizer.test.ts.summary: Unit tests deterministic EOB extraction, duplicate-category detection, required member liability, USD enforcement, and fixture-only zero defaults without exposing diagnosis data.

file:app/bill/[invoiceId]/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:app/bill/[invoiceId]/page.tsx.summary: Renders the Spanish-first synthetic patient bill page for the fixed BeneBot invoice, including secure-context messaging, a reconciled historical claim breakdown, and the conversation launcher. It explicitly separates the historical EOB from any current benefits lookup.

file:components/bill/bill-breakdown.tsx.name: bill-breakdown.tsx
file:components/bill/bill-breakdown.tsx.summary: Presents the deterministic Spanish-language arithmetic for Jane Doe's historical synthetic claim, including billed, discounted, allowed, insurer-paid, and patient-responsibility amounts. Source and date labels prevent the historical deductible from being mistaken for current eligibility.

file:components/bill/bill-experience.tsx.name: bill-experience.tsx
file:components/bill/bill-experience.tsx.summary: Implements the client-side transition from the bill into a secure BeneBot conversation by requesting a server-created session token and rendering the voice/text panel only after validation. It provides loading and Spanish error states while advertising English support and avoiding repeated identity collection.
